summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish, characterized by massive long-dated call accumulation in index products (SPX/SPXW) and semiconductor leaders (NVDA, MU, AMD). The dominant pattern is extreme "LEAPS" buying, specifically the $880.9M SPX 6000C (May 2026) and $219.5M SPX 7000C (Sept 2026), signaling a high-conviction bet on long-term market expansion. Persistent interest is confirmed by the $1B+ accumulation in the SPX 6000C (May 2026) and $979.1M in the SPX 6000C (June 2026) over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor sector (NVDA/MU) and monitor if SPX price action respects the massive liquidity walls established at the 6000 and 7000 strike levels.
